answer: Require each identity to escrow a 980-unit bond and serve a forty-one epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for twenty rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 980 units per alias and replays forty-one rounds, while a fable of matched traces exposes the ring, dune rotation scatters tasks, and bridge-sealed receipts certify provenance.
